production_behavior: The authenticated same-origin BFF reports scientific capabilities first. Model readiness reads the delivered scientific catalog. Run routes are registered and called only when a durable scientific batch reader exists; artifact availability is reported independently. The cancel command is registered only when a durable cancel writer exists and is advertised as run_control. The per-model dispatch policy routes are registered only when the durable policy repository exists and are advertised as model_policy. Production has no fixture fallback; fixture data is enabled only by Vite fixture mode and tests.

routes.behavior: Records the durable cancel request under the run's tenant with the operator subject as audited actor and returns the refreshed run detail; 409 once the run is terminal.

One row per catalog model (plus any model that still owns a policy row or live batch) in the operator's authorized scope: desired scope row, inherited all-tenants row, effective dispatch state, and durable queued/running counts.

Replaces one scope row at exactly expected_revision (0 when absent) under the model's dispatch lock and records an audit row; 409 scientific_model_policy_stale when the revision moved, 404 for a model outside the catalog. Pausing stops new controller dispatch only; running work drains, results publish, and Kueue quota, node pools, per-run resources and input caps are never raised.

access.native_gate_invariant: Native AlphaFold3 and native BindCraft/PyRosetta are admitted by generated deployment-bound use and execution authorization, never a caller licence receipt. Formal acceptance is advisory. Alternatives retain a distinct model identity and explicit-alternative relationship.

attempt_admission.invariant: Actual Kueue admission is projected only from the persisted controller or canonical result record; missing values remain unavailable and are never inferred from scheduling preference.

gpu_accounting.invariant: Every numeric GPU value includes its evidence state and source. Estimated and unavailable values are visibly labelled and never rendered as measured.

pending_producers.scientific-artifacts: canonical artifact results and semantic validation

counts.queued: accepted and durable, not yet dispatched, not cancelling
counts.running: dispatched to Kubernetes/Kueue and not terminal

model_policy.invariant: The console shows desired and effective policy separately with live counts. It never presents a paused or capped model as an always-hot resident runtime or GPU snapshot; only batch jobs exist.
